mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize member discussions without violating trust?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Use AI to prepare a digest from approved discussions, lessons, events, and announcements, then have a person check privacy, attribution, accuracy, and member usefulness. Summaries should not expose private comments or imply that every member agreed with a viewpoint.

Context: Community summaries can save time, but they also compress nuance and may reveal information that was shared in a limited setting. Run My AI Biz’s source-verification and approval principles apply directly to this workflow.

Key factors:
- Which channels and posts may be included
- Whether member names or quotations are allowed
- Summary audience and access tier
- How corrections will be handled

Practical guidance: Ask for themes, decisions, open questions, and next steps rather than a transcript. Remove identifying details unless permission is explicit.

Run My AI Biz can help structure recurring digest workflows while keeping publication under human control.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can prepare a digest if the source channels, audience, privacy rules, and attribution standards are clear. Summarize themes and next steps, remove unnecessary identifying details, and have a person check the draft before sharing it.
